title: Sakura Taisen 2: Kimi, Shinitamou Koto Nakare
native_title: サクラ大戦２ ～君、死にたもうことなかれ～
overview:
In an alternate 1920s Japan powered by steam, two years have passed since the Great Demon War. Ogami returns to the Imperial Theater to lead the Flower Division, a theater troupe that is secretly Japan's elite defense force, piloting steam-powered armor against demons. Two new members have joined the team, and a new enemy has appeared - the mysterious secret society known as the Black Demon Society.

In the adventure part, talk with the girls of the troupe and build your relationships through timed dialogue choices. How they feel about you affects how well they fight. In the battle part, command your upgraded units across turn-based isometric battlefields, plan your strategy carefully and unleash special attacks.

- Story spans three discs
- For 1 player
